name: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd
title: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Ltd - 543989 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Retail saree chain FY26 revenue +13.1% to ₹1,654 cr on ~69k net sq ft adds, but Q4 growth slowed to 5.1% and EBITDA margin is guided to only 17.5–18% in FY27 from ~16%; no capacity-cut or supply-discipline signal, store expansion is accelerating.

capex.quote: we should be able to expect at least 20% more than last year's square addition easily

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 5.1% YoY
triggers.quote: We delivered a revenue of about INR419 crores, representing a growth of 5.1% Y -o-Y despite a relatively mixed consumption environment

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 17.5–18%
triggers.quote: we should at least be in the 17.5% to 18% range this year

triggers.label: Net sq ft addition ~100k in FY27
triggers.quote: the net square feet addition in this year will be in the range of 100,000

triggers.label: Inventory days ~180, no target
triggers.quote: 180 days was the last year's inventory days, which is still too high. So, any target here?

guidance.quote: the net square feet addition in this year will be in the range of 100,000

guidance.value: similar to a little bit better than FY26 (>3%)
guidance.quote: we do anticipate a similar to a little bit better SSSG numbers than we've achieved this year
we should at least be in the 17.5% to 18% range this year
we should be able to expect a decent EBITDA about the full year EBITDA plus at least 50 basis points in the next year
we have budget on the advertisement side to still be able to run at 4% kind of a number only

prior_guidance_check.metric: EBITDA margin ~19% by FY27 (200 bps/yr path)

red_flags.label: Q4 growth slowdown to 5.1%, Tamil Nadu flattening
red_flags.quote: Tamil Nadu also in last 2 quarters, we have started seeing a bit of flattening out as well as decline in sales in Q4

red_flags.label: Telangana sales stagnation, KLM decline
red_flags.quote: Telangana FY23, we did INR600 crores of sales in FY26 , we are at INR500 crores

red_flags.label: Inventory ~180 days, no target
red_flags.quote: 180 days was the last year's inventory days, which is still too high

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin ~14.6% on bonus, labour code, advertising
red_flags.quote: all of this is where the EBITDA actually took a beating in the quarter 4

evasions.quote: Normally, format-wise sales are something that dissemination of the information is detrimental to the interest of the company.
if I convey a KPI on this within the system, then it is taking a negative toll on the sales part
the specific mathematics we will discuss in the Q2 call
it will be difficult for me to give you a revenue guidance right now
